posts.name: Pranav Kanala
posts.cooked:
Hi. I’ve registered for OPPE only in this term as I finished the theory component in the previous one. But I can see that I’m able to access all the weekly assignments and other stuff (mails that seem more general). Is that normal? I just want to be sure I’ve not re-registered for the full course and missing deadlines.

Also, should I submit the NPPEs and the (new) Bi weekly programming tests? Are they part of the grading for me?

Thank you.

posts.name: Mohammad Aban Ali
posts.cooked:
Also, last time there were 2 oppe and this time there is only one oppe. So, if we are evaluated according to this term’s grading policy won’t we be losing some marks.
Please guide @Subendu sir @sushil1 sir.

posts.name: sushil_sys
posts.cooked:
Dear Student,

If you have registered for the OPPE component alone you need not do anything in the portal. We have initiated querry in the regards with ops.

posts.name: sushil_sys
posts.cooked: The OPPE conducted this term will be used to in stead of OPPE1 and OPPE2 in the grading formula from the last term.

posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked: Refer the May 2024 grading document for the schedule. It will either be August 18 or 25.

posts.name: Pranav Kanala
posts.cooked:
@sushil1 @22F3002354
The doc says Oppe 1: 21 July, Oppe 2: 18/25th Aug. So since there is only one OPPE, should we consider the OPPE 2 dates?

posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked: Yes, there is no OP1, only OP2.

posts.name: Mohammad Aban Ali
posts.cooked:
Respected team,
As the grading pattern for system commands has changed a lot with respect to last term. My query is regarding how will be the students who have opted for OPPE only will be graded, since we have to give 1 oppe only, how will our bpt marks be deduced? Also what about bonus and VMT marks and Quiz 2 marks, will they be counted?

@sushil1 @22F3002354
Thanks in advance.
